structure.unit: Programs, Courses of Instruction and Textbooks
Programs and Courses of Instruction Generally

text.section: In the elementary grades of every public school the following subjects shall be taught: Spelling, reading, writing, arithmetic, grammar, geography, health and physical education, drawing, civil government, history of the United States and history of Virginia.
Physical education shall include activities such as, but not limited to, cardiovascular, muscle building, or stretching exercises, as appropriate.
